words.sense: sexual restraint without an unmarried-life requirement

semantic_axes.description: Celibacy combines a choice not to marry with sexual abstinence; chastity concerns sexual restraint without requiring lifelong unmarried status.

edges.boundary_rule: Celibacy combines a choice not to marry with sexual abstinence; chastity concerns sexual restraint without requiring lifelong unmarried status.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Rehan's commitment?

beats.text: Rehan has chosen never to marry and to abstain from sexual relationships.
beats.reason: Both parts of the lifelong choice are present.

beats.text: When relatives invite him to weddings, he celebrates with them without revising his own plan.
beats.decisive_clue: wedding invitations do not alter the vow
beats.reason: Attending weddings does not change his decision to remain unmarried and abstinent.

chains.feedback_short: Attending weddings does not change his decision to remain unmarried and abstinent.
chains.feedback_deep: Celibacy refers to deliberately staying unmarried and abstaining from sex. Chastity involves sexual restraint but does not itself rule out marriage. Attending weddings does not change his decision to remain unmarried and abstinent.
chains.contrast_rule: Celibacy rules out marriage; chastity does not.

hints.attention: Look at his own intentions, not the invitations.
hints.axis: Celibacy combines a choice not to marry with sexual abstinence; chastity concerns sexual restraint without requiring lifelong unmarried status.
hints.contrast: Celibacy rules out marriage; chastity does not.

beats.text: Priya decides to avoid sexual intimacy while she dates.
beats.reason: Restraint alone does not entail avoiding marriage.

beats.reason: Her plans to marry clarify that she has not chosen an unmarried life.

beats.text: They still enjoy spending time together after his weekend matches.

beats.decisive_clue: a ring does not establish an unmarried vow
